description: This file defines an Angular service class 'ImportExportService' responsible for importing and exporting various entities such as dashboards, widgets, profiles, rule chains, images, and bundles within the Thingsboard platform. It handles file operations, dialog interactions, and communication with backend services for data serialization, validation, and transfer.
